remarks: Downtown Greenwich - This luxury, two-bedroom town home has been renovated. It has a loft which overlooks and from which you can see the primary bedroom. (Note loft is accessed through primary bedroom and cannot be used as a bedroom per code - great for an office or work-out area). This unit has a terrace, plenty of closets and ample storage space. There's a private parking lot. Max 2 cars/unit. Please no pets. Note, pictures of another unit with similar finishes and floor plan. Actual unit for rent is being shown which is painted white. Water and trash is included. Close to Greenwich Avenue, school, train, shopping and restaurants.
